title: Internet & WWW: Searching & Citing
welcome_lead: Anyone can post anything online — so check before you trust.
meta_desc: KS3 web: search engines, evaluating sources, plagiarism.
final_note: Smart searchers find facts fast and credit their sources.

walkthroughs.body_html: Pick strong keywords — nouns and specific terms. Quotes search exact phrases. site: limits to one website.
Ask: who wrote it? When? Do other sources agree? Government, university and major news sites are usually reliable.
Always cite sources. Copying without credit is plagiarism. Even rewording — you still owe a citation.
